name: platform_process_stress
logic_name: Opt-in Process and Watch Stress Workloads

test_list.description: Spawn and stop 1,000 owned process trees on the local native backend.
Build a real five-descendant tree and verify all descendants exit after stop.
Flood a bounded watcher with 100,000 creates and require an explicit rescan signal.

output_description: Opt-in stress tests assert real process cleanup and explicit watcher rescan after overflow.
